name: postmortem
description: A blameless postmortem. Step 4 of the Landing Loop: reads a bet's landing brief, its incidents (live through the Leader Report's PagerDuty and incident.io collectors, CSV as the fallback) and its landing/<bet>.json record up to landed, says what changed with the evidence for each, and gives every fix one owner and a due date. Writes only the postmortem key and one HTML page. Also writes a single incident's postmortem from PagerDuty or incident.io, Slack, the deploy log and Sentry, with every time computed in code.
